# Bundled addon regression fixture

`nexus-dev-smoke-bundled.mcaddon` is the exact 636-byte fixture rejected by the
development validator with `MISSING_MANIFEST` on 2026-10-26.

It contains `nexus_dev_smoke_bp.mcpack`, which contains a version-2 behavior-pack
manifest with a `data` module and `functions/nexus_test.mcfunction`. The function
executes a single `say` command. This fixture was generated for BedrockNexus;
it contains no third-party game assets.

SHA-256:
`03890f8cb6869f8660907458cc941b78527d390701558f4afec60c9b9ee5cde9`

The archive test reads the complete bundle through the actual ZIP range reader
and checks the embedded manifest. Additional fixtures for malformed archives
and resource limits are generated by the tests.
